validationPhases: Definition: validate known fields, functions, arity, and literal/signed-numeric-literal control arguments; do not evaluate general constant subtrees.

Helper: validate supplied value arguments left-to-right, including every nonnull concat argument and all nonnullable controls.
Then return logical missing or perform the operation. Ternary and boolean short circuit remain unchanged.
